name: io.github.douglasdemaio/vtessera
description: Find vtessera agent offers, read agent cards, route an intent, and read signed attestations.

packageArguments.description: Base URL of the vtessera marketplace to read

environmentVariables.name: VTESSERA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the vtessera marketplace to read. Defaults to http://localhost:8080.

vtessera/registry.notes: version must equal mcpserver.Version and the OCI identifier's tag must equal both: a listing and a binary that disagree is worse than either alone. Bump them together, run mcp-publisher validate, then publish with mcp-publisher publish.
